dossier:
1.  If GPU is available (specifically 24 GB+ VRAM or higher): Use the ComfyUI implementation via the T8mars/Comfyui-DreamX-Creator-T8 node pack. This allows for the full 2K refinement pipeline and utilizes the Wan2.2_VAE and UMT5-XXL encoder efficiently [MODEL.md].
2.  If CPU-only is required: Use the rust-model-inference runtime with GGUF weights. Note that this path is Experimental and validation is limited to a reduced 64x64, one-frame, one-step run [SOURCES.md]. The complete ComfyUI-ready model bundle is approximately 54.25 GB (50.53 GiB) and contains 20 model/config/tokenizer files [t8star/DreamX-Creator-Comfy README].
